title: Miniature lemon and grape still life for dollhouse in 1:12 scale
description: A bright and detailed miniature still life with lemons, grapes, mandarins, a ceramic vase, a tiny book, and an amber glass jar. Every element was sculpted, painted, and arranged by hand. All items are securely glued to the base. Perfect for collectors, dollhouse decoration, kitchen and garden scenes, dioramas, fairy gardens, and creative photo styling. This miniature composition will add a warm Mediterranean touch to any setting. Not suitable for children.
